en: Milindapañha 7:
The Chapter on Similes— The Table of Contents (Mātikā)
“Venerable Nāgasena, endowed with how many factors does a bhikkhu realize arahantship?
“In this regard, Great King, by a bhikkhu desiring to realize arahantship—
one factor of a donkey must be adopted.
Five limbs of the cock are to be taken;
one limb of the squirrel is to be taken;
one limb of the doe is to be taken.
Two qualities of a lamp should be adopted.
Five qualities of a tortoise should be adopted.
One quality of a bamboo should be adopted.
One quality of the bow is to be adopted;
two qualities of the crow are to be adopted;
two qualities of the monkey are to be adopted.
The first chapter, on the Donkey.
One quality of the gourd vine is to be adopted;
three qualities of the lotus are to be adopted.
Two factors of the seed are to be taken up;
one factor of the salākalyāṇikā plant is to be taken up;
three factors of the ship are to be taken up.
Two qualities of the helmsman are to be adopted.
One quality of the mast is to be adopted.
Three qualities of the navigator are to be adopted.
One quality of a laborer should be adopted.
Five qualities of the ocean should be adopted.
The second chapter on the ocean is concluded.
Five factors of earth are to be grasped.
Five factors of water are to be grasped.
Five factors of fire are to be grasped.
Five qualities of wind should be taken up.
Five qualities of a mountain should be taken up.
Five qualities of space should be taken up.
Five qualities of the moon are to be adopted.
Seven qualities of the sun are to be adopted.
Three qualities of Sakka are to be adopted.
Four qualities of a wheel-turning monarch are to be adopted.
This is the third chapter, on the earth.
One quality of an ant is to be adopted.
Two qualities of a cat are to be adopted.
One quality of a rat is to be adopted.
One quality of a scorpion is to be adopted.
One quality of the mongoose should be adopted;
two qualities of the old jackal should be adopted;
three qualities of the deer should be adopted.
Four qualities of the ox are to be adopted.
Two qualities of the boar are to be adopted.
Five qualities of the elephant are to be adopted.
The fourth chapter, the Chapter on Ants, is concluded.
Seven qualities of a lion are to be adopted;
three qualities of a ruddy goose are to be adopted.
Two parts of a peṇāhikā (a kind of lizard) are to be taken.
One part of a house-pigeon is to be taken.
Two parts of an owl are to be taken.
One quality of the satapatta bird should be adopted.
Two qualities of the bat should be adopted.
One quality of the leech should be adopted.
Three qualities of the snake are to be adopted;
one quality of the python is to be adopted.
The fifth section, on the lion, is concluded.
One quality of the monkey at the crossroads should be adopted;
one quality of the infant lying on its back should be adopted;
and one quality of the painted tortoise should be adopted.
Five qualities of the wind should be adopted.
Three qualities of the tree should be adopted.
Five qualities of the cloud should be adopted.
Three qualities of the jewel-treasure are to be adopted.
Four qualities of the hunter are to be adopted.
Two qualities of the fisherman are to be adopted.
Two qualities of the woodcutter are to be adopted.
This is the sixth chapter, on the monkey.
One quality of the water-jar is to be adopted.
Two factors of black iron are to be taken up.
Three factors of a parasol are to be taken up.
Three factors of a field are to be taken up.
Two factors of medicine should be taken up.
Three factors of food should be taken up.
Four factors of archery should be taken up.
The seventh chapter is the Kumbha-vagga.
Four qualities of a king are to be adopted.
Two qualities of a gatekeeper are to be adopted.
One part of the *nisaḍha* plant should be taken;
two parts of the lamp-stand should be taken;
and two parts of the peacock should be taken.
Two qualities of a horse are to be adopted.
Two qualities of a distiller’s fermenting vessel are to be adopted.
Two qualities of a city gatepost are to be adopted.
One quality of the balance is to be adopted;
two qualities of the rhinoceros are to be adopted;
two qualities of the fish are to be adopted.
One factor of the debtor is to be taken;
two factors of the sick person are to be taken;
two factors of the dead person are to be taken.
Two factors of the river are to be taken;
one factor of the ox is to be taken;
two factors of the path are to be taken.
One quality of a customs officer is to be adopted.
Three qualities of a thief are to be adopted.
One quality of a hawk is to be adopted.
One quality of a dog should be adopted;
three qualities of a physician should be adopted;
two qualities of a pregnant woman should be adopted.
One quality should be adopted from the female osprey;
two qualities should be adopted from the female hen;
three qualities should be adopted from the female dove.
Two factors of the one-eyed man are to be adopted.
Three factors of the farmer are to be adopted.
One factor of the jackal Jambukasiṅgālī is to be adopted.
Two qualities of a caṅgavāraka (a type of water-strainer) are to be adopted.
One quality of a ladle is to be adopted.
Three qualities of a debt-collector are to be adopted.
One quality of the gatherer should be adopted.
Two qualities of the charioteer should be adopted.
Two qualities of the overseer should be adopted.
"One quality of the tailor should be adopted;
one quality of the mariner should be adopted;
two qualities of the bee should be adopted."
The Schedule is finished.
